title: Implement compact Pi rendering for all web tools
description: Add compact default renderResult and readable model-visible output for web_search, web_fetch, and web_research. Keep structured details available, show only a small preview by default, support expanded details, and remove raw JSON from normal chat-visible output.

logs.msg: Parent plan: replicate prior extension collapsed renderResult behavior while keeping model content readable and structured details separate; raw JSON is not acceptable.

Implemented readable bounded model output and custom compact/expanded Pi renderers for web_search, web_fetch, and web_research. Added deterministic renderer/output tests; full check passes (139 tests, 333 assertions).
